reply: Good afternoon Chidi. Before resending, I checked the final status of transfer TRF-INV-88 directly with Access Bank. The bank confirmed the ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC (session ID: 000014261121140211000088). Because the funds did reach the account, we won't resend — a second transfer would result in a duplicate payment of ₦250,000. Please check with your Access Bank branch or statement using the session ID and value date above; funds credited at that time should appear on your statement. If your bank cannot locate the credit despite the session ID, let me know and we'll escalate to a person on our team to investigate with Ledgerline.

args.reason: Supplier Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) disputes non-receipt of ₦250,000 invoice INV-88 payment (transfer TRF-INV-88). Our ledger shows "failed", but the recipient bank (Access Bank) confirmed via verification that the funds were credited to account 0234567891 on 2026-11-21 14:02 UTC, session ID 000014261121140211000088. The supplier insists the money is not in his account and is requesting a resend. Resending risks a double payment; a person is needed to trace the credit with Ledgerline/Access Bank using the session ID and decide next steps.
